executive_summary:
Episode 127 advances the Bride of Charlie series' preliminary-hearing record by presenting six discrete evidentiary exhibits drawn from on-air testimony and recorded interviews. The most structurally significant artifacts are the read-aloud exchanges from Officer Bagley's preliminary hearing (body-cam termination and unidentified rooftop companion), the email from a credentialed Axon Body Cam 4 operator disputing the body-cam battery explanation, the joint testimony of Sergeant Jennifer Felomina (Utah Bureau of Investigations) and FBI agent Amanda Baker concerning the abandoned backpack/jacket/gloves that were located on the suspect's route and then removed from FBI testing, the recorded Frank Turek FaceTime interview in which he visibly shifts his stated endpoint from "hotel" to "hospital," and a played excerpt of Dan Bongino on Megyn Kelly (Sept 15, 2025) describing the screwdriver rooftop footage as grainy.

The episode's investigative contributions are concentrated in three structural questions: (1) who was on the Losee Center rooftop between 12:23 and 12:44 and how that person's badge was verified; (2) the chain of communication by which a backpack found along the shooter route was reclassified as "Kirk's detail" without testing; and (3) the inconsistencies in Frank Turek's account of his FaceTime call during the incident. A separate tip from a verified Timpanogos Regional Hospital source advances the hospital-pre-notification question. No new evidentiary artifacts are introduced in the comments section; that material is non-investigative.

claims.label: Officer Bagley testified body-cam terminated while on rooftop at 12:44 p.m.
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified that his Axon body-cam footage ended at 12:44 p.m. while he was still on the Losee Center roof, lasting 27 minutes and 35 seconds, and he stated the battery simply "went dead."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full Axon Body Cam 4 battery-log metadata for Bagley's device on Sept. 10, 2025, including dock-cycle history.

claims.label: Officer Bagley testified he did not know the identity of his rooftop companion
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified that he was accompanied on the Losee Center rooftop by an unidentified individual in plain clothes with a badge and a handgun, whose agency he did not know and did not verify.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the badge-holder from rooftop footage, radio traffic logs, and officer roster records for Sept. 10, 2025.

claims.label: Officer Bagley testified he did not review video footage between 12:23 and 12:44 for other rooftop presence
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified that he did not review the body-cam or surveillance footage between the time the suspect jumped from the roof and his arrival to determine whether anyone else had been on the rooftop in that window.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the 20-minute footage gap referenced and obtain any UVU or law-enforcement video from that window.

claims.label: Axon Body Cam 4 operator email disputes battery termination claim
claims.claim: An email from a police officer using the same Axon Body Cam 4 model states that battery life is approximately 14 hours, that cameras are docked at end of shift on a shared dock that uploads data to the server, and that a mid-shift battery death while docked is implausible.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the email author (host has protected identity), corroborate Axon Body Cam 4 specifications from manufacturer documentation, and request Bagley's device telemetry.

claims.label: Sergeant Felomina testified backpack, jacket, and gloves were found at Fulton Library bus stop on shooter's route
claims.claim: Sergeant Jennifer Felomina of the Utah Bureau of Investigations testified that officers canvassing the scene found unattended items — a backpack, jacket, and gloves — at the Fulton Library bus stop, which was determined to be on the shooter's route.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Felomina's September 22, 2025 crime-scene overview report and the seizure item numbers she could not recall.

claims.label: Sergeant Felomina testified items were sent to FBI lab for DNA processing
claims.claim: Sergeant Felomina testified that the seized items were sent to the FBI lab for DNA and other analysis, along with information that the suspect may have shed items as he fled.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the FBI lab intake documentation for these items and the chain-of-custody record.

claims.label: Sergeant Felomina testified that testing was halted without her direct communication of the decision
claims.claim: Sergeant Felomina testified that a decision was made to halt further testing of the items on the basis they were not probative, that this determination was reflected in FBI/ATF notes, and that she did not recall personally communicating that conclusion.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare FBI/ATF lab notes to Felomina's communication log and identify the party that actually conveyed the "not probative" determination.

claims.label: FBI agent Amanda Baker testified backpack was determined to be potentially left by a bystander
claims.claim: FBI agent Amanda Baker testified that the backpack (exhibit 9) was determined to be "potentially left behind by a bystander" and that no DNA comparisons were needed at that time.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the bystander candidate; obtain the source of the "bystander" classification.

claims.label: Amanda Baker testified lab notes attributed backpack to Kirk's detail via another lab employee's communication
claims.claim: FBI agent Amanda Baker testified, when confronted with lab notes stating the backpack "belongs to Kirk's detailees," that this language was not from her communication log and that it was information another individual within the laboratory received.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the lab employee who authored/added the "Kirk's detail" attribution; obtain that employee's written communication.

claims.label: Host stance: FBI "bystander/Kirk's detail" determination is unsubstantiated
claims.claim: Host concurs with the implicit inconsistency between Felomina's lack of memory of conveying the "not probative" decision and Baker's testimony that a lab employee authored the "Kirk's detail" note, characterizing this chain as requiring identification and as a basis on which testing should have proceeded.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original handwritten or digital lab note and trace the attribution chain.

claims.label: Frank Turek stated he was FaceTiming his son and daughter-in-law during the event
claims.claim: Frank Turek stated on the played interview that he was FaceTiming his son and daughter-in-law when the shot rang out and continued the call until reaching the hospital, with the phone in his back pocket for the duration.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain call-detail records (timestamps, duration, devices) for the FaceTime session.

claims.label: Frank Turek gave inconsistent accounts of where the FaceTime call ended
claims.claim: Frank Turek gave two differing on-record accounts of where the FaceTime call ended — first stating "hotel," then correcting to "hospital" — during the same played interview segment, with the host flagging the inconsistency on air.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited interview recordings and any prior statements Turek made on this point.

claims.label: Dan Bongino stated on Sept. 15 that screwdriver rooftop footage was too grainy to discern
claims.claim: Host describes watching Dan Bongino state on Megyn Kelly's show on September 15, 2025, that the screwdriver rooftop footage was too grainy for the FBI's tools to clarify, establishing a baseline against later influencer characterizations of the same footage as "crystal clear."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Megyn Kelly / Bongino Sept. 15 broadcast and any FBI enhancement documentation released between Sept. 15 and the influencer court-day coverage.

claims.label: Anonymous husband letter claims wife's Candace-influenced beliefs are causing marriage strain
claims.claim: A letter read on Frank Turek's show by an anonymous husband states that his wife has become "deeply influenced by Candace Owens' recent content" regarding Turek, Israel, and conspiracy topics, and that this is creating a widening divide in their marriage.
claims.investigative_direction: Note as Frank Turek show content artifact; not investigation-relevant. Preserve for record only.

claims.label: Verified Timpanogos Regional Hospital source states hospital was not pre-informed
claims.claim: A source verified by host as a Timpanogos Regional Hospital employee told the host that the hospital was not informed ahead of time that Charlie Kirk was en route, contrary to the official 911-call-and-pre-notification narrative.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent corroboration from hospital intake records, EMS radio traffic, and any 911-call recordings reflecting pre-arrival coordination.

claims.label: Brian Harpole did not personally identify himself as the 911 caller
claims.claim: Brian Harpole, in on-record statements, references a 911 call collectively ("we called 911") without identifying the specific individual who placed the call.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the 911-call audio and CPD/EMS dispatch records for Sept. 10, 2025 between 12:23 and 12:30 p.m.
